name: saule
description: Language support for the Saule programming language: syntax highlighting plus a full language server (diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, document symbols, inlay hints, signature help, and formatting).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Saule runs a language server and a compiler on your files, so it needs a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The language server reads project files from disk.

saule.server.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `saule-lsp` executable. When empty, the extension honours the `SAULE_LSP_PATH` environment variable, then `#saule.toolchainDir#`, then `saule-lsp` on your `PATH`, and finally `~/.saule/bin`. Set in User settings only: a project cannot choose which program this extension runs.

saule.cli.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `saule` executable used by the **Saule: Run File** and **Saule: Run Project** commands. Resolved the same way as `#saule.server.path#`, honouring the `SAULE_PATH` environment variable.

saule.toolchainDir.markdownDescription: Directory containing the Saule toolchain binaries (`saule`, `saule-lsp`). Used when no explicit path is set for a binary.

saule.server.extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the saule-lsp server on startup.

saule.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Saule language server.

saule.allowProjectBuild.markdownDescription: Run the Saule binaries from a project's own Cargo build output (`target/release`, `target/debug`), found by walking up from each workspace folder, ahead of the installed toolchain. For working on Saule itself. **Off by default:** with it on, opening a folder runs any `target/debug/saule-lsp` that folder contains.
